additional_observations: run_phase() for phases 3 and 4 now includes RB_ENGINE_ENABLED checks that were previously missing. This is a necessary companion change for per-symbol mode to work in single-phase mode — in scope for AC9.

Fallback when no per-symbol pools found gracefully degrades to single RB Governor call.
Minimum data thresholds (train<100, val<50) are a reasonable guard to prevent RB Governor from running on insufficient data.
